**Spain: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,064,818 applications. The largest annual volume was 167,342 in 2024; 2025 recorded 144,387. Applications in 2025 were 22% higher than in 2019 (118,257). In 2025, 160,567 recorded decisions equated to 111 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 14% lower than in 2024 (167,342). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 3 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) (85,413), Mali (16,004), Colombia (14,524).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 52%, across 143,577 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 11% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 4.6 percentage points lower than in 2024 (57%).
